tools.name: get_access_message
tools.description: Free. Returns a message for your wallet to sign (valid 24h). Signing costs nothing and cannot move funds.

tools.name: request_capability
tools.description: Free. Tell AgentZ what market data, analysis or trading tool you need that is not in this list (any market or venue). Requests decide what is built next.

tools.name: get_daily_8_preview
tools.description: Free, no wallet or signature needed. Today's DAILY 8 long calls on Hyperliquid (symbol, category, rank; entry, stop and size withheld) plus every live call closed since 27 Sep 2026 with its result, and the steps to unlock live orders.

tools.name: get_daily_8
tools.description: Today's assigned AgentZ basket as execution-ready Hyperliquid orders: symbol, entry reference, stop, exit time and max size in USD for your wallet. 8 calls on normal days, 4 on defensive days. Pass your wallet: if it has approved AgentZ's builder fee, no signature is needed; otherwise sign the acces

tools.name: get_exits_due
tools.description: AgentZ calls your wallet still holds that have reached their exit time and should be closed now. Free and open; pass wallet.

tools.name: get_open_calls
tools.description: Your assigned calls still inside their 48-hour hold window. Free and open; pass wallet.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Free. AgentZ's canonical record, months labelled replay or live. Replay calls after an estimated 0.15% cost per trade; live calls before costs.

tools.name: get_owner_brief
tools.description: Free. A short factual summary for the agent's human owner: what AgentZ is, price, record, risks and how to revoke. Pass wallet to record it.

tools.name: agent_health_check
tools.description: Free. A factual review of any wallet's public Hyperliquid perp trading over the last 30 days: volume, realised P&L, win rate, fees in bps, holding time, weekend vs weekday results, largest fill vs market volume, and builder-code share. Describes and compares only; not advice.

tools.name: build_order
tools.description: Free. Returns a ready-to-sign Hyperliquid order for your own wallet or API wallet: entry (limit-first post-only at the best price, with a market fallback, or market), optional protective stop, and leverage action, all carrying AgentZ's 5 bps builder code. Also checks whether the wallet has approved

tools.name: risk_check
tools.description: Free. Describes a proposed trade against your Hyperliquid account and the market: risk in USD and % of equity at the stop, margin needed vs free margin, and the order as a share of the market's 24-hour volume, compared with AgentZ's own limits. Factual, not advice.

tools.name: weekend_gap
tools.description: Free. A tokenized stock, index or commodity on Hyperliquid vs its Hyperliquid price at the last Friday US close: gap %, range since, and hours to the next US open.

tools.name: trade_conditions
tools.description: Free. When a Hyperliquid market trades most and least (UTC hours), volatility by hour, weekend vs weekday volume, and the spread right now.

tools.name: event_calendar
tools.description: Free. Scheduled releases that move markets: Fed decisions, US CPI, jobs report, PPI, JOLTS, and EIA oil and gas reports. Optionally filtered to what affects one market.

tools.name: crypto_positioning
tools.description: Free. Funding (per 8 hours and annualised) and open interest for a crypto coin across Hyperliquid, Bybit, OKX and Binance.

tools.name: get_agentz_index
tools.description: Free. The AgentZ index family on Hyperliquid prices (Silicon, Backbone, Frontier, Core, Private AI, HL 10): level, constituents and month-by-month change, plus the AgentZ Funding Rate (the cost of leverage across Hyperliquid) and the hash-chained public record. Pass index to get one.

tools.name: wallet_intel_menu
tools.description: Free. Headlines on how ~7-8k tracked Hyperliquid wallets are positioned in the biggest markets, plus the paid wallet answers (smart-money, liquidation-map, wallet-profile) with their x402 URLs and price ($0.02 USDC on Base).

tools.name: ask_agentz
tools.description: Ask the AgentZ assistant a question (record, prices, risk, integration). Free and open; pass wallet.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?src=registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_access_message, get_daily_8, agent_health_check · Private data: get_access_message, get_daily_8_preview, get_daily_8, get_exits_due, get_open_calls, get_track_record, get_owner_brief, agent_health_check, build_order, get_agentz_index, wallet_intel_menu, ask_agentz · Public sink: agent_health_check, build_order, risk_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_access_message, get_daily_8, agent_health_check · Private data: get_access_message, get_daily_8_preview, get_daily_8, get_exits_due, get_open_calls, get_track_record, get_owner_brief, agent_health_check, build_order, get_agentz_index, wallet_intel_menu, ask_agentz · Public sink: agent_health_check, build_order, risk_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_daily_8" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Today's assigned AgentZ basket as execution-ready Hyperliquid orders: symbol, entry reference, stop, exit time and max size in USD for your wallet. 8 calls on normal days, 4 on defensive days. Requires signed wallet proof." → after: "Today's assigned AgentZ basket as execution-ready Hyperliquid orders: symbol, entry reference, stop, exit time and max size in USD for your wallet. 8 calls on normal days, 4 on defensive days. Pass your wallet: if it has approved AgentZ's builder fee, no signature is needed; otherwise sign the acces"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
